purpose: Explanatory SVG animation synchronized to an actual causal two-endpoint audio capture, not a protocol simulation.
sourceRevisionNote: Repository revision containing the retained capture and finalized validation, before adding this explainer.
protocol: custom experimental AIP-FSK2; authenticated with a provisioned PSK, not encrypted or fax-compatible

audio.processing: Untrimmed, unchanged speed, original stereo channel order; AAC encoding and 8 kHz to 48 kHz resampling only. No speech, normalization, added tones or soundtrack.

timing.basis: Blind CRC-confirmed replay from actual live link-delivery recording; MAC verified separately by live endpoint results. No key or expected payload input.
timing.boundaryQuantization: Exact metadata boundaries rendered on a 30 fps grid (within one frame). The recording timestamps are link-delivery chronology, not endpoint authentication-event timestamps.

exportValidation.method: Extract MP4 audio to stereo 8 kHz PCM; blindly decode without timings or expected messages; then compare all decoded packet hashes/channels/types to the original.
exportValidation.note: The initial 80 kbit/s export recovered only six packet CRCs and was discarded. The retained export preserves all seven exact packet hashes. This validates this export, not arbitrary codecs or carrier paths.
